descriptions.general: Default model, working directory, system prompt, permission mode and always-allowed tools.
descriptions.appearance: Theme, font scale, language and motion.
descriptions.apiKey: Anthropic API key (used by the local sidecar).
descriptions.ccswitch: Reuse providers, MCP servers, prompts and skills from CCSwitch — switch the active subscription with one click.
descriptions.agents: External agents — Claude Code CLI, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and any custom command speaking ACP / OpenCode / HTTP.
descriptions.agentModes: Built-in and custom agent modes — system prompt, tool list, output format and live preview presets.
descriptions.agentRuntime: Built-in Anthropic SDK sidecar — defaults, permission mode, always-allow tools, built-in tool categories, sidecar diagnostics, and the A2UI bridge.
descriptions.agentTeams: Multi-agent team templates — manager-worker, parallel specialists, research squad. Browse built-ins, duplicate to fork, or create new templates.
descriptions.hooks: Lifecycle hooks for ~/.claude/settings.json (User / Project / Local). 21 events × matcher × command-or-webhook handlers.
descriptions.slashCommands: Built-in, custom, and plugin-contributed slash commands — browse, search, and copy a command into the composer.
descriptions.tools: Built-in shell, filesystem, git, process and environment tools — global on/off, risk levels, and always-allow management.
descriptions.search: Web search providers (Tavily, Brave, Bing, Google, Perplexity, Exa…), defaults, cache, safety and source verification.
descriptions.ocr: OCR providers (Mistral OCR, Google Vision, AWS Textract, Azure DI, Claude / GPT / Gemini vision, Mathpix, OCR.space, ABBYY, Nanonets, Lark) plus on-device engines (Tesseract WASM/native, Windows.Media.Ocr, Apple Vision, Android ML Kit, ocrs, PaddleOCR) and the self-hosted HTTP adapter. Includes auto-router, PDF fast-path, and result cache.
descriptions.speech: Voice input (STT) language and microphone, plus read-aloud (TTS) provider, voice and auto-play.
descriptions.characters: Reusable personas with their own model and skills.
descriptions.skills: Reusable instruction blobs appended to system prompts.
descriptions.subagents: Sub-agent templates and live runtime — spawn focused workers from a parent agent for research, code review, content, or analysis sub-tasks.
descriptions.presets: Reusable session configurations — system prompt plus model, tool, MCP, and skill overrides.
descriptions.artifacts: Auto-detect code, HTML, React, SVG, Mermaid, charts, math and Jupyter notebooks into a side-panel workspace.
descriptions.canvas: Monaco-based code/document editor with AI actions, version history, inline suggestions, sandboxed execution and collaboration.
descriptions.mcp: Model Context Protocol servers (stdio / SSE / HTTP).
descriptions.data: Export, import or wipe local IndexedDB data.
descriptions.logs: Log levels, transports (console / IndexedDB / native / remote / Langfuse / OpenTelemetry), retention, redaction and per-module sampling.
descriptions.diagnostics: Crash logs, recent errors, and native logging diagnostics with export bundles.
descriptions.desktop: Tauri-only window, autostart and tray behavior.
descriptions.scheduledTasks: Configure cron-style automation, agent permissions, and resource limits
descriptions.a2ui: Agent-to-UI mini-apps, runtime defaults, MCP bridge, and debugger.
descriptions.plugins: Browse, install, configure, and govern plugins. Review permissions, scheduled jobs, devtools, and contract audits.
descriptions.remoteControl: Local HTTP listener for inbound triggers, plus webhook signing and custom headers for outbound calls.
descriptions.externalBridge: MCP server that exposes Cognia's wiki, RAG, and runtime entities to external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Cline). Opt-in per scope.
descriptions.automation: Desktop UI automation — screenshot, find element, click, type, send keys. Disabled by default; gated by a three-tier permission policy with a global kill switch.
descriptions.companion: Mobile companion server — bind mode (loopback / LAN), QR pairing, paired devices, and revocation.
descriptions.providers: AI provider API keys, models, and connection settings.
descriptions.connections: Configure messaging platform adapters (Telegram, Discord, Slack, ...) and manage the outbound delivery queue.
descriptions.subscription: Sign in with your Claude Pro/Max subscription, monitor 5h/7d rate-limit windows, and manage OAuth credentials in your OS keychain.
descriptions.network: HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 proxy for all outbound network traffic. Auto-detect Clash Verge, Mihomo, V2Ray and other local proxy tools.
descriptions.workflows: Visual n8n-style orchestration over characters, teams, skills, twins, and connectors. Trigger via cron, webhook, platform message, or manual run.
descriptions.goals: Persistent chat goals (ADR-0019). Set an objective with /goal and the agent auto-continues until a judge confirms it's done, or budgets / timeouts kick in.
